name: ferriheme
description: Any iron(III)-porphyrin coordination complex. The differentia is the +3 oxidation state of the iron. The formal charge written on the iron in SMILES does not show it (ChEBI draws ferriheme b with an Fe(+1) centre), but it can be computed from the structure, for example with RDKit's CalcOxidationNumbers, and it equals the Fe charge in the standard InChI. It is a property of the iron atom rather than of the molecule, so none of the current grouping patterns can define this class. Members state it on their iron AtomOccurrence via oxidation_number.
